g.text: Guided tour (Help > Start tutorial, or the startup offer)
IsDialogOpen? (no tour under an open dialog: return)
(temp folder: sample templates, a sample synced
folder, two sample backups, a settings copy)

Each TourStep: title, text, target control,
Enter / Leave actions (open a page, show a menu picture),
optional corner for the card. The overlay dims everything
but the target, blocks input, Esc skips.
